aircraftTypes.scope: Static reference for flight.aircraftType. One record per IATA type code, retaining all source-listed models. Historical and proposed models are included; presence does not imply active service or Pearson use.
aircraftTypes.classificationBasis: Reference assignments to the existing IFATC A-F key, not ICAO aerodrome code letters. IFATCFamilyExample follows a listed family; SizeEstimate is an editorial size analogy; ConservativeGroupEstimate uses the largest class among models sharing a code. No per-stand compatibility is established. Null means no supported class.

serviceTypes.Passenger: Source-listed passenger configuration, including business aviation.
serviceTypes.Cargo: Dedicated freighter or cargo transport configuration.
serviceTypes.Combi: A source-listed mixed passenger/cargo configuration; not a cargo-only flight.
serviceTypes.SpecialPurpose: Survey, tanker or other special mission; not an ordinary passenger or cargo service.

aircraftTypes.serviceTypeScope: Multiple serviceTypes mean the code can cover different roles, not that the current flight performs them all. Generic commuter and utility types with cargo conversions list Passenger and Cargo. This is not a complete conversion inventory; establish actual service from flight or operator data before selecting passenger gates or cargo stands.
